sources.title: Original T5 release README
sources.evidence: The October 23, 2019 repository snapshot explicitly lists T5-11B among released model checkpoints, linking gs://t5-data/pretrained_models/11B and giving nominal 11 billion parameters. It describes pretraining and downstream fine-tuning in a text-to-text encoder-decoder framework.

sources.title: Original T5 release commit metadata
sources.evidence: Author timestamp 2019-10-23T23:34:41Z and committer timestamp 2019-10-23T23:52:05Z date the snapshot that already links released T5-11B weights. Later February 2020 publicity is not used as the initial release date.

sources.title: Original Google T5-11B checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Downloaded only the 21,276-byte TensorFlow index, not weight shards. Decoded variable shapes from SSTable/Snappy BundleEntry metadata: 509 unique BF16 model tensors sum to 11,307,321,344 elements after excluding Adafactor slot variables and global_step. Encoder 4,831,892,480; decoder 6,442,529,792; shared embedding 32,899,072. No partition aliases or cross-attention relative-bias tensor; exactly two self-attention relative-bias tables. Every retained tensor byte length equals twice its element count.

sources.title: Original T5-11B operative configuration
sources.evidence: 24 encoder and 24 decoder blocks, d_model=1024, d_ff=65536, d_kv=128, 128 heads, dense ReLU feed-forward layers. Encoder/decoder share the embedding, decoder embedding/softmax weights are tied; relative attention bias is shared across layers. Config sets input/target lengths and max_length to 512, disables absolute positional embeddings, and uses vocabulary padding divisor 128.

sources.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
sources.evidence: Original research describes dense encoder-decoder Transformers, text inputs and outputs, relative-position bias, shared input/output vocabulary, nominal 11B variant, and multitask pretraining combining denoising with supervised tasks. Length 512 is documented for training/fine-tuning. No separately defined active-parameter count, dedicated thinking mode or native tool-call capability is supplied.

sources.title: Pinned original T5-11B Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Exact original T5 config matches Google dimensions: 24 layers per stack, d_model1024, d_ff65536, d_kv128, 128 heads, vocabulary32128 and 32 relative-position buckets. n_positions512 is metadata; it is not a learned absolute-position table or verified universal serving cap.

sources.title: T5 model implementation
sources.evidence: Defines dense self-attention and decoder cross-attention, two-matrix ReLU feed-forward layers, scale-only layer normalization and shared token embeddings/output weights. Relative biases occur only for the first self-attention block of each stack. Cross-attention is constructed without relative bias; old converted unexpected cross-attention bias keys are ignored. Shape-based formula agrees exactly with the original Google checkpoint index.

sources.title: T5 11B model card
sources.evidence: Identifies original T5-11B checkpoint and its Google Research authors, text-to-text uses, C4 plus supervised multitask pretraining, and Apache 2.0 license. Card is authored by Hugging Face, not a separate claim of a Google-authored card; original checkpoint evidence is used for parameter count.

sources.title: Original T5 Apache License 2.0
sources.evidence: The original released project carries Apache License 2.0, consistent with the exact checkpoint model card.

sources.title: T5X released-model documentation
sources.evidence: Later first-party documentation explicitly separates original T5 11B from T5 1.1 XXL, LM-adapted and Flan variants, with differing shapes and embedding sharing. No active-parameter specification for original T5-11B was found here; later-model capabilities/counts are not transferred.

name.note: Original T5-11B variant, not T5 1.1 XXL, Flan-T5 or T5Gemma.

developer.note: Google Research model; individual authors are listed in the original report.

release_date.note: Retain the original repository release date: the dated snapshot already states that the exact 11B checkpoint has been released. Later blog publication and HF conversion dates are distinct.

open_weights.note: Public Google checkpoint release; its tensor index was accessed directly without credentials.

license.note: Exact checkpoint card explicitly says Apache 2.0; original release repository carries the same license.

parameters_b.note: Complete original model count in decimal billions, verified by original TensorFlow checkpoint index and independent configuration formula. 509 unique BF16 tensors: encoder 4,831,892,480 + decoder 6,442,529,792 + shared token/output embedding 32,899,072 = 11,307,321,344. Excludes optimizer slots/global_step; no quantization metadata or extra converted cross-attention bias. Embeddings shared by encoder, decoder and output are counted once. 11B is the nominal size name; no weight payloads were downloaded.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined per-token active count is reported for original T5-11B in reviewed primary evidence or later original-model documentation. Dense total is not copied into this field: encoder computation and autoregressive decoder computation occur in different phases.

architecture.note: Dense Transformer encoder-decoder: 24 encoder and 24 decoder blocks, bidirectional encoder self-attention, causal decoder self-attention and encoder-decoder cross-attention, with relative-position bias and ReLU feed-forward layers; no routed experts.

context_window.note: 512 is the documented training/default input and target length (also n_positions metadata), not a verified universal maximum input context. Relative-position bias does not impose a fixed absolute-position table, and deployment limits depend on configuration; do not invent an unlimited supported context either.

modalities.note: Original checkpoint maps tokenized text inputs to generated text; no vision or audio encoder.

reasoning.note: Task benchmarks and text generation do not establish a dedicated thinking/reasoning feature for this original checkpoint; later Flan reasoning results are a different model.

tool_call.note: No native tool/function-call capability is specified for original T5-11B; task-specific fine-tuning or an external wrapper would not verify this base checkpoint flag.

description.value: Original T5 encoder-decoder model pretrained with span corruption and supervised text-to-text tasks.
description.note: Plain description of original model structure and multitask pretraining, without implying modern instruction/chat tuning.

sources.label: Original Google T5-11B checkpoint tensor index
Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer

patch.notes: The 11B name is nominal. Original checkpoint metadata gives 11,307,321,344 unique parameters across encoder, decoder and one shared token/output embedding; optimizer state is excluded. Active parameters are not separately defined. The documented 512-token training/default length is not a verified hard context limit. Release date follows the original repository snapshot linking the released checkpoint.

summary: Replace nominal 11B with exact 11.307321344B from the original Google checkpoint index, independently reconciled with the full encoder-decoder configuration and tied embedding. All 14 fields checked; dense architecture and Apache-2.0 confirmed. Context, dedicated reasoning and native tools remain unverified; 512 is a training/default length rather than a universal cap. Active count remains undisclosed. October 23, 2019 original release retained.
